verdict.rationale: Penpot explicitly documents an open file format built on open standards (CSS, HTML, SVG, JSON) plus a documented API, access tokens, and webhooks for external tooling, directly supporting design portability outside the vendor editor. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the file format spec is fully documented and usable by third-party tools (only vendor docs cited), and no evidence of a published formal schema/spec document.
